subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Someone who does not care about rules
solution:
The correct answer is: **Nonconformist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Nonconformist"** refers to someone who does not follow established customs, attitudes, or ideas. (परंपरावादी नहीं)

 
 
• **Example: **As a **nonconformist**, she always challenged the traditional ways of doing things.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Illegitimate** (अवैध): Not authorized by the law; not in accordance with accepted standards or rules.

 
 
• **Example:** The company faced fines for its **illegitimate **business practices.
 
 
 
• **Tyrant** (तानाशाह): A cruel and oppressive ruler.
 
 
• **Example:** The **tyrant **ruled the country with an iron fist.
 
 
 
• **Vampire** (पिशाच): A mythical being that subsists by feeding on the vital essence (generally in the form of blood) of the living.
 
 
• **Example:** The legend of the **vampire **has been popular in literature and movies.
